question: Does the exact immutable #525 ward-mirror-edge packet provide current-main whole-run Duskblade policy sensitivity, reward/economy reachability and functional separation from Scoreline without material cross-package interference or guardrail regression?
method: One exact binary content intervention evaluated by a mechanism-blocked common-random-number whole-run first look. This is not the old four-factor or five-factor design and does not fit another scalar candidate.

wardContentPacket.contrast: exactWardCandidate minus currentMainBaseline on identical policy and simulation-seed identities

scorelinePayoff.causalRole: frozen shared interference anchor, not varied
scorelinePayoff.reason: Scoreline activation can change only through reward-pool, acquisition, combat-opportunity or global-run interference from the ward packet.

afterimagePayoff.causalRole: absent from this experiment and not aliased with Scoreline
afterimagePayoff.claimBoundary: No Afterimage endpoint or rescue claim is supported.

designMatrix.cells: Both content levels receive every named grid, every policy identity and every simulation seed. There are no optional or promising-only cells.
designMatrix.mechanismBlock: Dusk policy rows jointly measure Scoreline and ward activation on each identical policy identity. Ash policy and all RandomBuild grids are guardrail blocks, not package-effect factors.

anchors.scorelineInterference: Paired exactWardCandidate-minus-currentMainBaseline change in the binary Scoreline-active indicator for every Dusk policy identity.
anchors.randomBuild: Paired candidate-minus-baseline win indicator on each separately named aspect-vow grid.
anchors.identity: The canonical policy snapshot must be exact across both content arms, aspects and four simulation seeds and disjoint from every registered prior cohort.
anchors.expansionRule: No joint-cell expansion exists. Scoreline interference above the frozen decision threshold causes rejection or inconclusive classification; it does not authorise extra cells or content tuning.

dusk-scoreline.activation: The final deck contains both cards and one of four matched simulations records positive scorelineApplied and scorelineConsumed.
dusk-scoreline.reachability: The final deck contains both cards; consumer-reached additionally requires positive scorelineConsumed.

dusk-ward-mirror-edge.mediator: Ward gained by a registered producer and subsequently doubled by Mirrorlight
dusk-ward-mirror-edge.activation: For at least one registered producer, the final deck contains that producer and fortify and one of four matched simulations records both cards played plus positive wardDoubledByFortify.
dusk-ward-mirror-edge.edgeActivation: Each of brace and mirrorEdge is counted separately with the same final-pair, producer-play, fortify-play and positive-double requirements.
dusk-ward-mirror-edge.reachability: The final deck contains fortify and at least one registered producer; consumer-reached uses the complete activation witness.

candidate.selectionBoundary: This is the only candidate. It is copied byte-for-byte from immutable #525 evidence and is not generated, fitted, ranked or tuned by this protocol.

issue525.usableResult: The exact candidate passed both registered ward edges and discovery and validation probe/panel gates; it was not admitted on whole-run evidence.

scorelineComplementarity.usableResult: Dusk Scoreline independently cleared exact-candidate complementarity with 88 mechanism witnesses; the overall scalar candidate failed only the separate Afterimage package.

engineIdentity.usableResult: The exact Godot 4.7.1 replay is row-exact against the frozen path and subsequent null research settings preserve identity.

immutableScientificEvidence.scope: Read-only evidence only. This protocol does not rerun #524/#525 probes, reconstruct their historical search plan or revisit exhausted Kindle/Branch paths.

cohorts.commonRandomNumbers: Both content arms use every identical root-551 policy, all four policy simulation seeds and every RandomBuild seed on all named grids.
cohorts.novelty: Root 551 and seeds 346532-346599 must have zero prior ledger observations before execution.

heldOutReservation.authority: Remain unused unless decision boundary 1 freezes this exact candidate. A separate immutable held-out protocol must inherit the candidate, estimands and proportionally scaled gates before execution.

estimands.policyActivation: For each package and edge, aggregate the registered binary activation over the same four simulations for each root-551 policy identity.
estimands.policySensitivity: Count active and inactive policy identities for Scoreline and the union of the two registered ward edges.
estimands.rewardEconomyReachability: Count final-pair and complete consumer-reached identities for both packages and separately for Brace and Mirror Edge ward edges.
estimands.functionalSeparation: Count Scoreline-only, ward-only and cross-active policy identities on the same candidate rectangle.
estimands.scorelineInterference: Paired mean candidate-minus-baseline Scoreline-active indicator with a 95% policy-cluster bootstrap interval.
estimands.wardActivationImpact: Paired mean candidate-minus-baseline ward-active indicator with the same estimator; diagnostic only because admission is defined by candidate support and exact #525 complementarity.
estimands.randomBuild: Paired candidate-minus-baseline win indicator separately for every aspect-vow grid.
estimands.duration: Candidate-minus-baseline mean combat turns per fight for every matched policy simulation row.
estimands.reliability: Candidate faults and candidate-added faults on every complete policy and RandomBuild rectangle.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions.reason: Only one binary exact-content factor varies, so no factorial interaction is identifiable.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions.interferenceAnchor: The paired Scoreline activation contrast measures the only preregistered cross-package path: ward reward-pool and run changes altering acquisition or expression of an unchanged Scoreline package.

aliasStructure.exactPacketAlias: The seven #525 content edits and new common-pool entry vary together. Whole-run evidence identifies only the exact 0acbe... packet, not individual numeric fields or Mirror Edge in isolation.
aliasStructure.closedResearchKnobs: acquisitionPriority, wardSetupPriority, packageOrder, policyPackageOrder and policyPackageCommitment are all at exact null and are not factors.
invalidClaims: No field-level attribution inside the ward packet.
No detector, RC, product or protected-seed admission.
No inference from an endpoint outside a complete matched rectangle.

estimator.bootstrap: Exactly 5000 deterministic cluster-bootstrap resamples with a fresh random.Random(421) stream per estimand. Policy identity is the cluster for activation and RandomBuild seed is the cluster for grid movement.
estimator.pointEstimates: Means for paired binary or duration differences and exact counts for support gates.
estimator.multiplicity: No post-hoc endpoint, fitted threshold, alternate seed, candidate ranking or outcome-based cohort change.

gates.reliability: Zero candidate policy faults, zero candidate-added policy faults and zero candidate-added RandomBuild faults.
gates.provenance: The 16/16 sensitivity, eight reachability and four separation thresholds are the exact 64-policy proportional first-look versions used by the earlier mechanism-blocked protocol. RandomBuild, Vow-5 and duration thresholds are unchanged.

decisionRules.success: Both packages pass sensitivity and reward/economy reachability; both ward edges pass their separate reachability gate; functional separation, policy identity, Scoreline anchor, reliability, RandomBuild, Vow-5 and duration gates all pass.
decisionRules.futility: Reject at boundary 2 if a package, ward edge, separation, reliability, RandomBuild win ceiling or Vow-5 gate fails; a RandomBuild or Scoreline movement interval lies wholly beyond its threshold; or a duration lower bound exceeds 0.25 turns.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Record boundary 3 if an identity, immutable input, content load, complete rectangle, cache, engine, ledger, row-cap or wall-cap assertion fails, or only a movement/duration point or interval straddles its decision threshold.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze exactly candidate 4f02c9b... and its 0acbe... content for the preregistered root-552 independent whole-run confirmation. Do not evaluate another ward candidate or spend protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the exact ward-mirror-edge packet and tested level-2 direction without retuning; continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Stop at the preregistered cap. Do not rerun, extend, repair or tune this protocol.

deterministicOwnership: post_v38_ward_whole_run_discovery.py alone verifies immutable evidence, caches the exact candidate, constructs both CRN rectangles, invokes exact Godot 4.7.1, records the append-only ledger, computes every registered estimand and chooses the decision boundary with zero model-context tokens.
methodBoundary: No ML, RL or optimiser is authorised. The exact candidate was selected by immutable #525 evidence; this experiment answers only its missing current-main whole-run admission question.
